g.text: Physical-page reach and lead time at seven future LLC arrivals

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Eligible = a page in the last 64 Stride arrivals and at least 130 cycles of lead. Missed/late = original NoPF miss and no timely or ordinary hit in all three reference arms (each records miss/late).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each row uses up to 32,768 uniform unfiltered anchors. Median lead uses observed event time. Source: labels/results/*__stride_horizons.csv
